advantages.name: Combat Reflexes
advantages.description: You react quickly to threats. +1 to initiative, faster recovery from surprise, and extra defense rolls.

advantages.name: Enhanced Defenses
advantages.description: Improves your ability to defend against attacks. This template applies it to Parry.

advantages.name: Force Sensitive
advantages.description: You can feel the Force. Prerequisite for all Force-related abilities.

advantages.name: High Pain Threshold
advantages.description: You are unusually resistant to the effects of pain, suffering fewer penalties from injury.

advantages.name: Iron Will
advantages.description: Grants +1 to Will. You have a stronger will than most.

advantages.name: Weapon Master
advantages.description: You are exceptionally skilled with a specific weapon type (Lightsaber).

disadvantages.name: Code of Honor (Jedi Code)
disadvantages.description: You are bound by the strict tenets of the Jedi Order.

disadvantages.name: Sense of Duty (Republic)
disadvantages.description: You feel a strong obligation to protect or serve the Republic.

disadvantages.name: Vow (No Attachments)
disadvantages.description: You are sworn to avoid forming deep personal attachments, in accordance with Jedi tradition.

quirks.name: Curious
quirks.description: You have a strong desire to know things, sometimes to your detriment. You might poke your nose into places it doesn't belong or ask too many questions.

skills.name: Lightsaber Combat
skills.notes: The signature skill for wielding a lightsaber.

skills.name: Tactics
skills.notes: The skill of planning and executing strategies in combat.

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.notes: The skill of tumbling, balancing, and performing complex gymnastic feats.

skills.name: Leadership
skills.notes: The ability to inspire confidence and direct troops.

skills.name: Meditation
skills.notes: The skill of focusing the mind to recover Force Points.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.notes: The ability to move silently and remain unseen.

skills.name: Survival (Forest)
skills.notes: Finding food, water, and shelter in forest environments.

skills.name: Lightsaber Construction
skills.notes: The art and meditation of building a lightsaber.

skills.name: Movement
skills.notes: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive, relevant Force power (e.g., Force Jump, Force Speed). Description: The skill of using the Force to push one's body beyond its natural physical limits, enabling superhuman feats of speed, agility, and leaping.

skills.name: Telekinesis
skills.notes: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive, relevant Force power (e.g., Force Push/Pull). Description: The ability to manipulate physical objects and project kinetic force at a distance, from levitating small stones to blasting enemies off their feet.

forcePowers.name: Force Jump/Leap
forcePowers.description: The Force-user enhances their physical jump or leap through an application of the Force.
forcePowers.effect: Double your effective Jumping skill distance.
Exert a telekinetic force equal to your Basic Lift (BL) on objects within 10 yards. Cannot inflict damage directly.
forcePowers.name: Force Push/Pull
forcePowers.description: The Force-user can telekinetically push or pull objects and beings.

combatTechniques.baseSkill: Any Ranged or Melee Weapon skill
combatTechniques.effect: You make a single attack with a -1 penalty to skill, but if it hits, you inflict +1 damage. This attack takes your full turn and prevents you from defending (treat as an All-Out Attack, but you specify 'Strong').
combatTechniques.name: Power Shot / Power Attack
combatTechniques.requirements: Any Ranged or Melee Weapon skill

lightsaberForms.name: Form I: Shii-Cho
lightsaberForms.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to your Parry score when using a lightsaber. You may target one additional opponent in a single attack action at a -4 penalty to skill for each additional target.

blasters.notesAndEffects: Max-Capacity Power Pack (200cr): Increases the number of shots (Shots) by 50%. This modification often increases the weapon's weight (Wt.).
blasters.name: Zabrak Battle Cannon
blasters.notes: A heavy weapon that ignores 1/2 DR.
